title: What It Was Like at Donald Trump’s Arraignment

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档聚焦设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带着300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班，你把DJ台变成了一个充满美丽50年历史文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Oh, hi Michael.
sentences.zh: 哦，嗨，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Good morning, good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好，早上好。

sentences.en: Hi, good morning.
sentences.zh: 嗨，早上好。

sentences.en: It's a nice day.
sentences.zh: 今天天气真好。

sentences.en: It's a nice day.
sentences.zh: 今天天气真好。

sentences.en: It's all you can ask.
sentences.zh: 夫复何求啊。

sentences.en: It's going to be a long day.
sentences.zh: 这注定是漫长的一天。

sentences.en: It's going to be like mid-60s, no jacket.
sentences.zh: 气温大概在60华氏度中期，不用穿外套。

sentences.en: So here we are.
sentences.zh: 我们到这儿了。

sentences.en: Here we are.
sentences.zh: 我们到这儿了。

sentences.en: Michael, can you orient us a little bit?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你能给我们介绍一下周围的情况吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: It is 10.20 a.m.
sentences.zh: 现在是上午10点20分。

sentences.en: Tuesday, April 4th, and you and I are standing at the bottom of what is essentially a small neighborhood of legal buildings and courthouses that,
sentences.zh: 4月4日，星期二，你我和我正站在一个小社区般的市政大楼和法院的底部，

sentences.en: if you've ever watched a procedural on TV, you recognize.
sentences.zh: 如果你看过电视上的罪案剧，你就会认出这里。

sentences.en: It feels like every episode of Law & Order has some scene shot at the steps of one of these courthouses.
sentences.zh: 感觉《法律与秩序》的每一集都会在其中某座法院的台阶上拍摄一些镜头。

sentences.en: And this is where history is going to be made today.
sentences.zh: 而今天，这里即将创造历史。

sentences.en: This is where Donald Trump is going to show up in his motorcade with the Secret Service, get out and surrender himself to the Manhattan District Attorney.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普将在这里乘坐特勤局的车队出现，下车并向曼哈顿地区检察官自首。

sentences.en: And this is where a few hours later, Donald Trump is going to be arraigned in court.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，唐纳德·特朗普也将在法庭上被提审。

sentences.en: Charges are going to be read to him.
sentences.zh: 各项指控将被宣读给他听。

sentences.en: He's going to have to enter a plea.
sentences.zh: 他必须进行抗辩。

sentences.en: That's the moment everyone's waiting for.
sentences.zh: 那是每个人都在等待的时刻。

sentences.en: In the meantime, people have gathered across the street from the courthouse to protest this indictment and this impending arraignment,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，人们聚集在法院街对面，抗议这份起诉书和即将到来的提审，

sentences.en: as well as express support for it and say that it needs to happen.
sentences.zh: 同时也表达对起诉的支持，并表示这是势在必行的。

sentences.en: And that is where we are headed now.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们现在要去的地方。

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: 我们走吧。

sentences.en: Okay, so this is interesting.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这很有意思。

sentences.en: This is a set of metal fences that are separating the two sides.
sentences.zh: 这是一组将双方隔开的金属栅栏。

sentences.en: It's, I think we're on the Trump side.
sentences.zh: 我想我们是在特朗普的支持者这一侧。

sentences.en: On the other side is opponents of Trump.
sentences.zh: 另一侧是特朗普的反对者。

sentences.en: There are definitely more reporters and tourists here than there are Trump supporters.
sentences.zh: 这里的记者和游客明显比特朗普的支持者还要多。

sentences.en: That's not entirely surprising.
sentences.zh: 这并不完全让人意外。

sentences.en: We are in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 我们在曼哈顿呢。

sentences.en: Why are you here?
sentences.zh: 你为什么来这里？

sentences.en: It's very, very complex.
sentences.zh: 这非常非常复杂。

sentences.en: It's hard to put it into a soundbite.
sentences.zh: 很难用一两句话说清楚。

sentences.en: He had sex with Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 他和斯托米·丹尼尔斯发生了性关系。

sentences.en: And what is that?
sentences.zh: 那又怎样？

sentences.en: What kind of crime is that?
sentences.zh: 那算什么罪行？

sentences.en: Trump should never have been in that office.
sentences.zh: 特朗普本来就不该坐上那个职位。

sentences.en: It's time.
sentences.zh: 时候到了。

sentences.en: It's long time coming.
sentences.zh: 这早就该发生了。

sentences.en: Tell me why you're here.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你为什么来这里。

sentences.en: Because they're arresting Donald Trump for nothing.
sentences.zh: 因为他们以莫须有的罪名逮捕唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: It's unjuSt.
sentences.zh: 太不公正了。

sentences.en: I think this is pretty ridiculous and it's pretty obviously a political hit job.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这挺荒谬的，很明显这是一场政治迫害。

sentences.en: The celebration is finally, finally there's some accountability.
sentences.zh: 这场庆祝活动意味着，终于、终于有人要被追究责任了。

sentences.en: You're calling this a celebration this rally?
sentences.zh: 你把这次集会称作庆祝活动？

sentences.en: This day?
sentences.zh: 今天这一天？

sentences.en: Yes, in a way.
sentences.zh: 是的，某种程度上是。

sentences.en: Just because there's accountability.
sentences.zh: 就因为能追究责任。

sentences.en: To get any accountability for someone doing criminal deeds and getting elected by, partially by doing criminal deeds is a celebration.
sentences.zh: 对于一个犯下刑事罪行、且部分靠犯罪当选的人进行追责，这值得庆祝。

sentences.en: I'm here to support former President Trump.
sentences.zh: 我来这里是为了支持前总统特朗普。

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？

sentences.en: I mean, I think if the crime, if any, was committed, it was harmless, didn't hurt anybody who cares who he was with, you know?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得如果有罪行的话，那也是无害的，没有伤害任何人，谁在乎他跟谁在一起呢，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm not a lawyer, so I can't say too much, but I can tell that people get away with much worse things in the city all the time, you know?
sentences.zh: 我不是律师，所以我不能说太多，但我看得出来，在这个城市里，人们经常能逃脱更严重的罪行，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Can you sound to what your shirt says?
sentences.zh: 你能念一下你衬衫上写的内容吗？

sentences.en: It says arrest Chuck.
sentences.zh: 上面写着逮捕查克。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that is happening today.
sentences.zh: 而这正在发生。

sentences.en: Oh, here we come.
sentences.zh: 哦，他们来了。

sentences.en: Police car has just made the turn.
sentences.zh: 警车刚转过弯。

sentences.en: Here it is.
sentences.zh: 车来了。

sentences.en: The motorcade has arrived.
sentences.zh: 车队到了。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日播客》。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: There he is.
sentences.zh: 他就在那儿。

sentences.en: I can see the back of Trump's head.
sentences.zh: 我能看到特朗普的后脑勺。

sentences.en: You can see him walking away.
sentences.zh: 你能看到他走开。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: What it was like as Donald Trump was charged with 34 felony counts.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普被控34项重罪时的情形。

sentences.en: Trump is now in the building.
sentences.zh: 特朗普现在已经在楼里了。

sentences.en: He is surrendering himself.
sentences.zh: 他正在自首。

sentences.en: He's here.
sentences.zh: 他到了。

sentences.en: This is all very, very real right now.
sentences.zh: 这一切现在都非常非常真实。

sentences.en: Literally right here at this corner of this street in Lower Manhattan, we are entering unchartered territory.
sentences.zh: 就在曼哈顿下城这条街道的这个转角，我们正进入一片未知的领域。

sentences.en: My colleague, Jonah Bromwich, takes us inside the courthouse where Trump was arraigned.
sentences.zh: 我的同事乔纳·布罗姆维奇将带我们进入特朗普受审的法庭内部。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, April 5th.
sentences.zh: 现在是4月5日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jonah, just to begin, how did you even get inside this courtroom?
sentences.zh: 乔纳，首先，你是怎么进入这个法庭的？

sentences.en: Because as I left Lower Manhattan for the day, I noticed all these reporters, some of them very famous TV personalities, waiting in a line looking really crestfallen because
sentences.zh: 因为当我离开曼哈顿下城时，我注意到所有的记者，其中有些还是非常著名的电视名人，排着队看起来非常沮丧，因为

sentences.en: they hadn't gotten into this courtroom.
sentences.zh: 他们没能进入法庭。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I hardly even know where to begin.
sentences.zh: 我几乎不知道该从哪里说起。

sentences.en: So we understood that the line was going to work in a certain way.
sentences.zh: 所以我们了解到排队会按某种特定方式进行。

sentences.en: People were going to line up.
sentences.zh: 人们会排队。

sentences.en: They were going to be given numbers.
sentences.zh: 他们会拿到号码。

sentences.en: And then they were going to get in the courtroom based on those numbers.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会根据这些号码进入法庭。

sentences.en: That turned out to be totally wrong.
sentences.zh: 事实证明这完全是错误的。

sentences.en: So the first assumption we made that was wrong was that the line would start sometime overnight, like kind of early Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 我们犯的第一个错误假设是排队会在夜间某个时候开始，比如周二清晨左右。

sentences.en: The line started at 2 p.m.
sentences.zh: 实际上排队从周一下午2点

sentences.en: on Monday.
sentences.zh: 就开始了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know, more than 24 hours before the arraignment was scheduled.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在预定的提审时间24小时前就开始了。

sentences.en: This is the line of journalists to get in the courtroom to see Donald Trump be arraigned.
sentences.zh: 这是记者们为了进入法庭旁听唐纳德·特朗普受审而排成的队伍。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we just got a little bit lucky in that I knew that there was supposed to be a line forming at one point.
sentences.zh: 我们只是稍微有点运气，因为我知道某个时候应该会开始排队。

sentences.en: My colleague, Sean Bacoli, was down at the scene.
sentences.zh: 我的同事肖恩·巴科利当时正在现场。

sentences.en: And I said, Sean, just keep an eye out for any lines that seem to be forming.
sentences.zh: 我对肖恩说，留意一下任何看起来正在形成的队伍。

sentences.en: I don't think it'll happen, but just see what you can do.
sentences.zh: 我觉得不会发生，但看看你能做什么。

sentences.en: And Sean said, there's a line.
sentences.zh: 肖恩说，有一条队伍。

sentences.en: There's three people in it.
sentences.zh: 里面有三个人。

sentences.en: I'm number four.
sentences.zh: 我是第四个。

sentences.en: And we had him and another of our colleagues, Nate Schweber, joined him.
sentences.zh: 我们让他和我们的另一位同事内特·施韦贝尔也加入了进去。

sentences.en: So we had spots number four and number seven in line.
sentences.zh: 所以我们占了队伍里的第四号和第七号位置。

sentences.en: And we coordinated reporters throughout the night.
sentences.zh: 我们在整夜里协调记者轮流排队。

sentences.en: And I got there shortly before seven.
sentences.zh: 我在七点前不久赶到了那里。

sentences.en: So somebody spent the night in that line for you.
sentences.zh: 所以有人替你在队伍里过夜了。

sentences.en: Multiple people spent the night in line for us.
sentences.zh: 多个人替我们在队伍里过夜。

sentences.en: This is Jonah Bromwich.
sentences.zh: 我是乔纳·布罗姆维奇。

sentences.en: I'm a courts reporter with The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的法庭记者。

sentences.en: Now I can see the tents.
sentences.zh: 现在我能看到帐篷了。

sentences.en: And the line of journalists who have been waiting since yesterday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 还有从昨天下午就开始等待的记者队伍。

sentences.en: So I showed up on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在周二现身的。

sentences.en: I took over Brittany Kriegstein's spot.
sentences.zh: 我接替了布里塔尼·克里格斯坦的位置。

sentences.en: She gave me her beach chair, which I later carried into the courthouse.
sentences.zh: 她把她的沙滩椅给了我，我后来把它搬进了法院。

sentences.en: All right, so I'm at the front of the line now, thanks to Brittany and Jason and five or six other colleagues who have been standing here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我现在排在队伍最前面了，多亏了布里塔尼、杰森以及其他五六个一直站在这里的同事。

sentences.en: In the meantime, helicopters are circling overhead and the sun is coming up over the federal court building to the south.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，直升机在头顶盘旋，太阳在南面联邦法院大楼上方升起。

sentences.en: And the tension in the line is just growing because you don't know whether you're going to get in.
sentences.zh: 队伍里的紧张气氛不断加剧，因为你不知道自己能不能进去。

sentences.en: And then finally, court officers are now coming and checking the line and it seems as if we're about to get our tickets.
sentences.zh: 然后终于，法警们走过来检查队伍，看起来我们好像要拿到入场券了。

sentences.en: This group of court officers descends out of nowhere and they start handing out these tickets.
sentences.zh: 这群法警不知从哪儿冒出来，开始分发这些票。

sentences.en: And there are three ticket colors.
sentences.zh: 票有三种颜色。

sentences.en: There's green, there's yellow and there's white.
sentences.zh: 有绿色的、黄色的和白色的。

sentences.en: I've got my green ticket, which is essentially the equivalent of the golden ticket into this room.
sentences.zh: 我拿到了我的绿票，这基本上就相当于进入这个房间的金奖券。

sentences.en: And it felt like getting a golden ticket, basically.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像拿到了一张金奖券一样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: And when do you actually lay eyes on Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候真正见到唐纳德·特朗普的？

sentences.en: So we get into the courthouse and then I walk into this 15th floor courtroom.
sentences.zh: 我们进入法院，然后我走进这个位于15层的法庭。

sentences.en: And I'm the first journalist to walk in, which was kind of remarkable and just luck of the draw, really.
sentences.zh: 我是第一个走进去的记者，这真是挺了不起的，说实话纯粹是运气好抽中了。

sentences.en: And sit down and wait.
sentences.zh: 然后坐下来等待。

sentences.en: Wait, you know, I'm sitting in the courtroom, so obviously I can't see anything.
sentences.zh: 等等，你知道的，我坐在法庭里，所以显然我什么也看不见。

sentences.en: But we do hear these faint cheers from the crowd outside.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实听到了外面人群传来的微弱欢呼声。

sentences.en: And so what we understood at that point is, okay, he seems to have made his way into the building.
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时理解的是，好吧，他似乎已经进到大楼里面了。

sentences.en: And then we know that he made his way up to the 15th floor and the prosecutors come in and the defense came in.
sentences.zh: 然后我们知道他上到了15楼，检方进来了，辩方也进来了。

sentences.en: And then Donald Trump walked into the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 接着唐纳德·特朗普走进了法庭。

sentences.en: And I'm so used to seeing Donald Trump on TV or in his social media photo, just kind of seeming larger than life.
sentences.zh: 我太习惯在电视上或他的社交媒体照片里看到唐纳德·特朗普了，他总是显得那么高大伟岸。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in that moment, what I see is someone who looks like a criminal defendant.
sentences.zh: 而在那一刻，我看到的是一个看起来像刑事被告的人。

sentences.en: He looks his age.
sentences.zh: 他显出了他的年龄。

sentences.en: He looks tired.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很疲惫。

sentences.en: He looks a little bit apprehensive.
sentences.zh: 他看起来有点忧心忡忡。

sentences.en: He really felt human.
sentences.zh: 他真的很有凡人的感觉。

sentences.en: And despite the court officers, despite all the hubbub, just seeing him, he looked significantly more normal than I would have expected him to.
sentences.zh: 尽管有法警在场，尽管有各种喧嚣，但亲眼看到他时，他看起来比我预期的要正常得多。

sentences.en: And it sounds like you're saying, from your experience watching him on TV, and in rallies, a little diminished.
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是，根据你在电视和集会上观察他的经验，他显得有点气势减弱。
是的，百分之百。

sentences.en: And as we talk about what happened in the hearing, I think that sense just amplified and grew.
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论听证会上发生的事情时，我觉得这种感觉更加强烈了。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: Once he's in the room and this proceeding starts, what's happening?
sentences.zh: 他一进房间，诉讼程序开始，发生了什么？

sentences.en: We're so used to, at this point, Donald Trump completely owning the room.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经习惯了唐纳德·特朗普完全掌控全场。

sentences.en: But the first thing that happens isn't even the arraignment.
sentences.zh: 但发生的第一件事甚至都不是传讯。

sentences.en: A lawyer for the assembled media stands up and argues that journalists should have greater access to this proceeding.
sentences.zh: 在场媒体的一名律师站起来，争辩说记者应该获得更多旁听此次诉讼的权限。

sentences.en: And Trump is not the center of attention.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普并不是关注的中心。

sentences.en: You know, he's off to the side.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他被晾在一边。

sentences.en: He's not speaking.
sentences.zh: 他没有说话。

sentences.en: He has to listen to this person he doesn't know.
sentences.zh: 他不得不听一个他不认识的人讲话。

sentences.en: And it really just sets the tone for everything that comes next.
sentences.zh: 这真的为接下来的一切定下了基调。

sentences.en: And what does come next?
sentences.zh: 那接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So 15 minutes go by, and that portion is over.
sentences.zh: 15分钟过去了，那部分结束了。

sentences.en: And then the judge, Juan Mershon, says, let's arraign Mr. Trump, please.
sentences.zh: 然后法官胡安·梅尔尚说，请传讯特朗普先生。

sentences.en: So they do.
sentences.zh: 于是他们照做了。

sentences.en: They start to arraign Mr. Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们开始传讯特朗普先生。

sentences.en: A court official reads out the charges for the first time.
sentences.zh: 法庭官员首次宣读了指控。

sentences.en: He's charged with 34 counts of falsifying business records in the first degree.
sentences.zh: 他被控34项一级伪造商业记录罪。

sentences.en: Which is a lot of counts.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当多的罪名。

sentences.en: That is a lot of counts.
sentences.zh: 这确实有很多罪名。

sentences.en: And the clerk asks him how he pleads.
sentences.zh: 书记员问他如何抗辩。

sentences.en: He leans forward.
sentences.zh: 他向前倾身。

sentences.en: He takes the mic.
sentences.zh: 他拿起麦克风。

sentences.en: And he says two of the only words he's going to say.
sentences.zh: 他说了他即将说出的仅有的几个字之一。

sentences.en: And it's so quiet because everyone has just been waiting to hear from Trump this entire time.
sentences.zh: 四周一片寂静，因为大家一直在等待听特朗普开口。

sentences.en: And the two words are not guilty.
sentences.zh: 这两个字是：无罪。

sentences.en: So the prosecutors take over.
sentences.zh: 于是检察官接手了。

sentences.en: They start to describe the charges and outline them and say what they mean.
sentences.zh: 他们开始描述指控、概述指控并说明其含义。

sentences.en: And it's the first time we've heard this story in a courtroom.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次在法庭上听到这个故事。

sentences.en: So the prosecutor, Chris Conroy, says that Trump falsified business records, and he did so to promote his candidacy in 2016.
sentences.zh: 检察官克里斯·康罗伊表示，特朗普伪造了商业记录，这样做是为了促进他在2016年的竞选。

sentences.en: And that's why we're here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们来到这里的原因。

sentences.en: But then Conroy goes further than that because he also talks about
sentences.zh: 但随后康罗伊更进一步，因为他还谈到了

sentences.en: Trump's true social posts of the last few weeks.
sentences.zh: 特朗普过去几周在“真实社交”上的发帖。

sentences.en: And this is something that I didn't expect to come up, frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，这是我没料到会出现的情况。

sentences.en: But Trump has recently tweeted, you know, that death and destruction would ensue were he to be charged.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普最近发推文说，你知道的，如果他被起诉，将会导致死亡和毁灭。

sentences.en: He's tweeted threatening things about the Manhattan District Attorney, Alvin Bragg.
sentences.zh: 他发过威胁曼哈顿地区检察官阿尔文·布拉格的推文。

sentences.en: Mr. Bragg is black.
sentences.zh: 布拉格先生是黑人。

sentences.en: And Mr. Trump has called him an animal.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普先生称他为动物。

sentences.en: So the language on truth social has been quite ugly.
sentences.zh: 因此，“真实社交”上的言论相当难听。

sentences.en: And Chris Conroy, this prosecutor, brings that up.
sentences.zh: 而这位检察官克里斯·康罗伊提到了这一点。

sentences.en: And again, I was just so struck because Trump, whose language we are talking about, even in the courtroom, is not speaking.
sentences.zh: 再次让我感到震撼的是，我们正在讨论其言论的特朗普，甚至在法庭上也没有说话。

sentences.en: And he's being spoken about.
sentences.zh: 他在被别人谈论。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he's being spoken about by people who have power over him.
sentences.zh: 而且谈论他的人是对他拥有权力的人。

sentences.en: Both the prosecutor and the judge who's hearing that complaint.
sentences.zh: 既有检察官，也有审理此案的法官。

sentences.en: And I have in my notebook, this is around 247, just the words, huge power shift.
sentences.zh: 我的笔记本上记着，大约在2小时47分时，只有这样几个字：巨大的权力转移。

sentences.en: Trump can't talk in here.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在这里不能说话。

sentences.en: Can't interrupt.
sentences.zh: 不能打断。

sentences.en: Judge and prosecutors hold sway.
sentences.zh: 法官和检察官掌握主导权。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Not a familiar dynamic.
sentences.zh: 这不是一种熟悉的动态。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: He's being silenced.
sentences.zh: 他被剥夺了话语权。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So what the prosecutor is doing here is that he's asking the judge to recognize that these statements have been problematic and potentially harmful.
sentences.zh: 所以检察官在这里做的是，他要求法官认识到这些言论是有问题且具有潜在危害的。

sentences.en: And he's asking the judge to weigh in on that.
sentences.zh: 他要求法官对此发表看法。

sentences.en: A defense lawyer, Todd Blanche, stands up and disagrees with the prosecutor, says that these posts were born of frustration.
sentences.zh: 辩护律师托德·布兰奇站起来，不同意检察官的观点，称这些发帖是出于沮丧。

sentences.en: And Mr. Trump has been frustrated by the way this case has been handled.
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普先生对处理此案的方式感到沮丧。

sentences.en: But then, as happens in a courtroom, both parties turn to look at the judge.
sentences.zh: 但随后，正如法庭上常有的那样，双方都转过身去看着法官。

sentences.en: And what the judge says to the defense lawyer is, I don't share your view that certain language and certain rhetoric is justified by frustration.
sentences.zh: 法官对辩护律师说的是，我不认同你的观点，即某些言论和修辞是由沮丧情绪正当化的。

sentences.en: And he tells him to warn Trump to refrain from making comments or engaging in conduct that has the potential to incite violence, create civil unrest,
sentences.zh: 他告诉律师要警告特朗普，避免发表评论或从事有可能煽动暴力、制造内乱的行径，

sentences.en: or jeopardize the safety or well-being of any individuals.
sentences.zh: 或者危及任何个人的安全与福祉。

sentences.en: This judge is basically admonishing Trump, who's sitting a couple feet away from him, to behave himself when it comes to this case.
sentences.zh: 这位法官基本上是在警告坐在离他几英尺远的特朗普，在这个案件上要安分守己。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: For his social media posts.
sentences.zh: 为了他自己的社交媒体发帖。

sentences.en: You know, Trump's social media posts are so at the heart of what makes him a public figure.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特朗普的社交媒体发帖正是他作为公众人物的核心所在。

sentences.en: And so to see those posts in particular come up in the courtroom in this way, that was really, really striking to me.
sentences.zh: 因此，看到这些发帖以这种方式在法庭上被提及，这真的让我感到非常非常震撼。

sentences.en: So how does this proceeding ultimately come to an end?
sentences.zh: 那么这个诉讼程序最终是如何结束的呢？

sentences.en: So there's a lot of procedural questions, and there's some back and forth between the lawyers.
sentences.zh: 有很多程序上的问题，律师之间也有一些来回交锋。

sentences.en: But that's pretty much it.
sentences.zh: 但差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: And then, all of a sudden, we're done.
sentences.zh: 然后，突然之间，我们就结束了。

sentences.en: So Trump stands up.
sentences.zh: 于是特朗普站了起来。

sentences.en: His lawyers stand up.
sentences.zh: 他的律师站了起来。

sentences.en: They all walk out, and it's over.
sentences.zh: 他们都走了出去，这就结束了。

sentences.en: We wait for a little while, and then we're released, and we rush out of the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 我们等了一会儿，然后获准离开，冲出了法庭。

sentences.en: And I turn my computer on, and I turn my phone on.
sentences.zh: 我打开电脑，打开手机。

sentences.en: And it's only then that we get a bunch of information from the DA's office
sentences.zh: 直到这时，我们才从地方检察官办公室获得了一堆信息，

sentences.en: that tells us a little bit more about the charges and the case, including the statement of facts.
sentences.zh: 向我们透露了更多关于指控和案件的信息，包括事实陈述。

sentences.en: And the statement of facts is what tells us that this is all going to be a little more complicated than we realized.
sentences.zh: 事实陈述告诉我们，这一切将比我们意识到的要复杂一些。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So Jonah, what exactly did we learn from the documents released by the district attorney on Tuesday that has made this case start to feel, as you said, a little more complicated?
sentences.zh: 乔纳，地区检察官周二公布的文件中，究竟透露了什么，才让这个案件开始变得像你所说的那样复杂一些？

sentences.en: Well, basically, the case is telling multiple stories.
sentences.zh: 嗯，基本上，这个案件讲述了多个故事。

sentences.en: That is also one big story.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个宏大故事的一部分。

sentences.en: So the first of those multiple stories is one that we knew about, and that's the hush money payment to Stormy Daniels that was made by Michael Cohen before the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 这些故事中的第一个是我们早就知道的，也就是2016年大选前迈克尔·科恩向斯托米·丹尼尔斯支付的封口费。

sentences.en: Then after the 2016 election, Trump reimbursed Cohen.
sentences.zh: 然后在2016年大选后，特朗普报销了科恩的费用。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he reimbursed him with a series of payments.
sentences.zh: 他是通过一系列付款来报销的。

sentences.en: Each of those payments and the related documents represents a count.
sentences.zh: 每一笔付款及相关文件都代表一项指控。

sentences.en: So when you look at the false statements made about those payments, in terms of how they were categorized, in terms of what was said about them at the Trump organization,
sentences.zh: 因此，当你查看有关这些付款的虚假陈述时，从它们的归类方式来看，从特朗普集团内部对它们的说法来看，

sentences.en: that's how you get to the filing false business records charge.
sentences.zh: 这就是你如何得出伪造商业记录指控的过程。

sentences.en: That is this entire case.
sentences.zh: 这就是整个案件的全部内容。

sentences.en: There's 34 of those.
sentences.zh: 总共有34项这样的指控。

sentences.en: Right, because the payments are allegedly mischaracterized by Trump and the Trump organization.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为这些付款据称被特朗普和特朗普集团做了错误的定性。

sentences.en: The Trump organization said that these were payments to Michael Cohen for ordinary legal work,
sentences.zh: 特朗普集团表示，这些是支付给迈克尔·科恩的普通法律工作报酬，

sentences.en: but they were reimbursements for the hush money that Cohen paid out of his own pocket to Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 但实际上它们是对科恩自掏腰包支付给斯托米·丹尼尔斯的封口费的报销。

sentences.en: You're saying there are 34 charges here because there are 34 instances of the Trump organization falsifying business records to cover up those reimbursements.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是这里有34项指控，因为特朗普集团有34次伪造商业记录以掩盖这些报销的行为。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So that's the part we knew a lot about before the surband.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我们在被传讯前就很清楚的部分。

sentences.en: So what else did we learn?
sentences.zh: 那么我们还了解到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, we learned, like I said, that there are multiple stories included in these documents that the prosecutors send out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如我所说，我们了解到检察官发出的这些文件中包含了好几个故事。

sentences.en: So one concerns a woman named Karen McDougal.
sentences.zh: 其中一个关于一个名叫卡伦·麦克杜格尔的女人。

sentences.en: She's a former Playboy model, and she says that she had a months-long affair with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 她曾是一名花花公子模特，她称自己与唐纳德·特朗普有过数月的婚外情。

sentences.en: And so Trump and his folks are worried that this story is going to come out during the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普和他的手下担心这个故事会在2016年大选期间曝光。

sentences.en: But this time, they coordinate with a media organization they're close to, the National Enquirer.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，他们与一家关系密切的媒体机构——《国家问询报》进行了配合。

sentences.en: And it's that organization that pays Karen McDougal, and they pay her for the exclusive rights to her story.
sentences.zh: 正是这家机构付钱给卡伦·麦克杜格尔，买下了她故事的独家版权。

sentences.en: Right, which is known as a catch-and-kill.
sentences.zh: 没错，这被称为“买断并埋没”。

sentences.en: Basically, the National Enquirer gets word that McDougal has this story about an alleged affair with Trump.
sentences.zh: 基本上，《国家问询报》听到消息称麦克杜格尔掌握了这个关于她与特朗普涉嫌婚外情的故事。

sentences.en: They offer to pay her for the story, and in so doing, they get her to sell the exclusive rights to the story.
sentences.zh: 他们主动提出为这个故事付钱，并以此让她出售该故事的独家版权。

sentences.en: So they now have control over it, but they never actually write the story.
sentences.zh: 所以他们现在控制了这个故事，但他们从未真正写出这个故事。

sentences.en: They never intend to write the story.
sentences.zh: 他们从没打算写这个故事。

sentences.en: They are catching it, and they are killing it.
sentences.zh: 他们买下它，然后埋没它。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: That's the idea, is to kill the story.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的主意，把这个故事扼杀掉。

sentences.en: And that's what happens to Karen McDougal's story.
sentences.zh: 这就是卡伦·麦克杜格尔的故事的结局。

sentences.en: And then there's a third story that's also similar.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一个类似的三号故事。

sentences.en: And this story involves a person who worked at Trump Tower as a doorman.
sentences.zh: 这个故事涉及一个在特朗普大厦当过门卫的人。

sentences.en: And the doorman says he has this story about Trump supposedly fathering a kid out of wedlock.
sentences.zh: 这名门卫说他掌握了一个关于特朗普涉嫌在婚外生子的故事。

sentences.en: And here again is an instance where the National Enquirer is the one who gets involved.
sentences.zh: 这里同样是《国家问询报》介入的情况。

sentences.en: They pay for the story.
sentences.zh: 他们为这个故事付了钱。

sentences.en: They kill the story.
sentences.zh: 他们把故事埋没了。

sentences.en: And the story doesn't appear during the 2016 campaign.
sentences.zh: 这个故事在2016年竞选期间没有出现。

sentences.en: And later they determined that the story wasn't even true.
sentences.zh: 后来他们断定这个故事甚至都不是真的。

sentences.en: And Jonah, how do these two cases that you just described, the Karen McDougal case and the doorman case,
sentences.zh: 乔纳，你刚刚描述的这两个案件——卡伦·麦克杜格尔案和门卫案，

sentences.en: how do they actually fit into the charges that have just been brought against Trump and that were described on Tuesday by the DA?
sentences.zh: 它们究竟是如何契合刚刚对特朗普提起、且周二由地方检察官描述的这些指控中的？

sentences.en: That's such a good question.
sentences.zh: 这真是个好问题。

sentences.en: The truth is we don't entirely know yet.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们目前还不是很清楚。

sentences.en: There's a good chance we won't know for some time here.
sentences.zh: 很有可能我们在短时间内都不会知道。

sentences.en: So the charges, those 34 counts, those relate to the Trump reimbursements to Michael Cohen for the Stormy Daniels payment, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，那34项指控，它们与特朗普向迈克尔·科恩报销斯托米·丹尼尔斯付款的事有关，对吧？

sentences.en: But in order to be a felony, those 34 charges have to include an intent to commit or conceal another crime.
sentences.zh: 但要构成重罪，这34项指控必须包含实施或掩盖另一项犯罪的意图。

sentences.en: And as of now, we don't know what that crime is.
sentences.zh: 而截至目前，我们还不知道那是什么犯罪。

sentences.en: And the reason we don't know what it is is because the prosecutors haven't yet said what it is.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以不知道，是因为检察官还没有说明那是什么犯罪。

sentences.en: And so it may be that by including all three of these stories in the story of the overall case, the prosecutors are trying to present a pattern of behavior
sentences.zh: 因此，通过将所有这三个故事纳入整个案件的叙事中，检察官可能是在试图展示一种行为模式，

sentences.en: that will help them sell that underlying crime to a jury.
sentences.zh: 这将有助于他们向陪审团说服那个潜在的底层犯罪。

sentences.en: And one theory of that underlying crime, and correct me if I'm wrong, is that it might be a crime involving campaign finance.
sentences.zh: 关于那个底层犯罪有一种理论，如果我说错了请纠正我，那就是它可能涉及竞选财务犯罪。

sentences.en: Because ultimately, the payments that were made to Stormy Daniels in the eyes of many people who know the law may have been illegal campaign donations, correct?
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，在许多懂法的人看来，支付给斯托米·丹尼尔斯的款项可能是非法的竞选捐款，对吗？

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: But we really just don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实还不知道。

sentences.en: Okay, so no matter what this second or underlying crime, however we want to describe it, no matter what that is, the reason that prosecutors have decided to tell all these stories,
sentences.zh: 好的，所以无论这个第二项或潜在的犯罪是什么——不管我们怎么称呼它，无论它是什么，检察官决定讲述所有这些故事的原因，

sentences.en: all three, is because you're saying it will firmly establish a kind of Trump MO, a pattern of behavior that a jury can look at.
sentences.zh: 全部三个，是因为你说这会牢固地确立一种特朗普式的惯用手法，一种陪审团可以看到的行为模式。

sentences.en: And they think that makes this a stronger case.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这会让这个案件变得更有力。
百分之百。

sentences.en: Prosecutors' job is to tell a persuasive story about Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 检察官的工作就是讲述一个关于唐纳德·特朗普的有说服力的故事。

sentences.en: And they can tell a story that just involves Stormy Daniels, but they don't know what a jury's going to make of that.
sentences.zh: 他们可以只讲一个涉及斯托米·丹尼尔斯的故事，但他们不知道陪审团会对此作何感想。

sentences.en: But if they tell a story that involves Stormy Daniels, and then they tell another one that sounds pretty similar, that involves Karen McDougal,
sentences.zh: 但如果他们讲了一个涉及斯托米·丹尼尔斯的故事，接着又讲了另一个听起来非常相似的、涉及卡伦·麦克杜格尔的故事，

sentences.en: and they tell a third one that involves a doorman, and in all of those stories, there's this common thread,
sentences.zh: 并且他们讲了第三个涉及门卫的故事，而在所有这些故事中，都有一个共同的线索，

sentences.en: which is burying a potentially damaging set of facts to help the campaign, that might be a lot more convincing.
sentences.zh: 那就是掩埋一套可能具有破坏性的事实来帮助竞选，这可能会更有说服力。

sentences.en: Right, because it's not just a common story, it's a common intent.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为这不仅是一个共同的故事，更是一个共同的意图。

sentences.en: It's a common motivation from Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 这是来自唐纳德·特朗普的共同动机。

sentences.en: That's exactly, exactly right.
sentences.zh: 这完全、完全正确。

sentences.en: Earlier this afternoon, Donald Trump was arraigned on a New York Supreme Court indictment, returned by a Manhattan grand jury.
sentences.zh: 今天下午早些时候，唐纳德·特朗普在纽约州最高法院提审，该起诉书由曼哈顿大陪审团作出。

sentences.en: And later on Tuesday, I actually went to a news conference that the district attorney, Alvin Bragg, held.
sentences.zh: 而在周二晚些时候，我实际去参加了地区检察官阿尔文·布拉格举行的新闻发布会。

sentences.en: The defendant repeatedly made false statements on New York business records.
sentences.zh: 被告在纽约的商业记录中多次作出虚假陈述。

sentences.en: He also caused others to make false statements.
sentences.zh: 他还唆使他人作出虚假陈述。

sentences.en: And he talked about Trump committing the same illegal acts again and again.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了特朗普一次又一次地实施相同的非法行为。

sentences.en: We today uphold our solemn responsibility to ensure that everyone stands equal before the law.
sentences.zh: 我们今天履行了庄严的责任，确保所有人在法律面前人人平等。

sentences.en: And why that was unacceptable to him.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么这对他来说是不可接受的。

sentences.en: Thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Okay, so Jonah, what happens next based on everything that you learned on Tuesday?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么乔纳，根据你在周二了解到的一切，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Where does this case now go?
sentences.zh: 这个案件现在走向何方？

sentences.en: I think we're going to keep seeing this case play out in two very, very different arenas.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们将会继续看到这个案件在两个非常、非常不同的舞台上展开。

sentences.en: On the campaign trail, where Trump is a presidential candidate, and in the courtroom, where he's a defendant.
sentences.zh: 在竞选集会上，特朗普是一位总统候选人；而在法庭上，他是一名被告。

sentences.en: And those are two very different roles.
sentences.zh: 这两个是截然不同的角色。

sentences.en: And it'll be really interesting to see whether they're reconcilable roles.
sentences.zh: 看看它们是否是能够调和的角色，将是一件非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: Because the Trump we saw in court today is so different from the Trump we're used to seeing.
sentences.zh: 因为我们今天在法庭上看到的特朗普，与我们习惯看到的特朗普大不相同。

sentences.en: Well, you mentioned earlier that the judge, in this case, warned Trump not to run around riling people up about the case.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你刚才提到，本案法官警告特朗普不要到处煽动民众讨论这个案件。

sentences.en: But beyond that, did today's legal proceedings put any real constraints on how Trump can talk about or campaign on the fact that he's been indicted?
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，今天的法律程序对特朗普谈论或围绕其被起诉的事实进行竞选，施加了任何真正的限制吗？

sentences.en: And does it put any restrictions on his travel or anything else related to his campaign?
sentences.zh: 它对他的旅行或与竞选相关的其他任何事情施加了限制吗？

sentences.en: So we don't quite know yet, but we will know soon.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在还不太确定，但我们很快就会知道。

sentences.en: There are going to be limitations on Trump.
sentences.zh: 对特朗普将会有所限制。

sentences.en: Those are related to what's called a protective order that's being drawn up between prosecutors and Mr. Trump's legal team.
sentences.zh: 这些限制与所谓的保护令有关，该保护令正由检方与特朗普先生的法律团队共同起草。

sentences.en: And that's going to dictate the way that Trump uses what's happening in the courtroom on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: 这将决定特朗普在竞选活动中如何利用法庭上正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And prosecutors don't want him to tweet evidence from the case.
sentences.zh: 检察官不希望他发布案件中的证据。

sentences.en: They don't want him to disclose things he's not able to disclose.
sentences.zh: 他们不希望他透露他不该透露的事情。

sentences.en: They ask that he not even look at certain material from the case unless he's in his lawyer's office.
sentences.zh: 他们要求他甚至不要查看案件中的某些材料，除非他在律师的办公室里。

sentences.en: So we don't know what is going to be in that final agreement.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道最终的协议里会有什么。

sentences.en: But there is going to be a document that constrains what Donald Trump can do and what Donald Trump can say.
sentences.zh: 但将会有一份文件来约束唐纳德·特朗普能做什么和能说什么。

sentences.en: And I'm very curious to see whether he can heed the terms of that document.
sentences.zh: 我很想看看他是否能遵守该文件的条款。

sentences.en: And what will happen if he does not?
sentences.zh: 如果他做不到，将会发生什么？

sentences.en: If he doesn't, the judge will have to make a decision about how to sanction the former president.
sentences.zh: 如果他做不到，法官将不得不就如何制裁这位前总统做出决定。

sentences.en: For so long, he's conflated his legal problems with political probleMs.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，他一直将自己的法律问题与政治问题混为一谈。

sentences.en: And he's turned legal problems into politics.
sentences.zh: 他把法律问题转化为了政治问题。

sentences.en: And it's one thing to do that when you're under investigation.
sentences.zh: 当你正处于调查中时，这样做是一回事。

sentences.en: But it's a whole other thing when you're a criminal defendant.
sentences.zh: 但当你是一名刑事被告时，完全是另一回事。

sentences.en: Well, Jonah, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，乔纳，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此深表感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, everybody.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: And we have to save our country.
sentences.zh: 我们必须拯救我们的国家。

sentences.en: God bless you all.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你们所有人。

sentences.en: God bless you all.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你们所有人。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night, Trump delivered a speech about the arraignment from Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，特朗普在海湖庄园就传讯发表了一场演讲。

sentences.en: And I never thought anything like this could happen in America.
sentences.zh: 我从未想过在美国会发生这样的事情。

sentences.en: Never thought it could happen.
sentences.zh: 从未想过这会发生。

sentences.en: The only crime that I have committed is to fearlessly defend our nation from those who seek to destroy it.
sentences.zh: 我犯下的唯一罪行，就是无畏地保卫我们的国家，免受那些企图摧毁它的人的侵害。

sentences.en: And despite the warning from prosecutors and the judge in the case,
sentences.zh: 尽管本案的检察官和法官发出了警告，

sentences.en: Trump attacked the proceedings and the judge himself, calling him a, quote, Trump hater.
sentences.zh: 特朗普还是攻击了诉讼程序以及法官本人，称他为引用的“特朗普仇恨者”。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由刚才你们听到的人们制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: In a political earthquake for Wisconsin and national politics, a liberal candidate, Janet Protisiewicz, has won a crucial seat on Wisconsin's Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 在威斯康星州和全国政治的一场政治地震中，自由派候选人珍妮·普罗齐维茨赢得了威斯康星州最高法院的一个关键席位，

sentences.en: flipping majority control away from conservative justices.
sentences.zh: 从保守派法官手中夺走了多数控制权。

sentences.en: As a result, the Wisconsin Supreme Court is likely over the next year to reverse the state's ban on abortion and end the use of gerrymandered legislative maps
sentences.zh: 因此，威斯康星州最高法院很可能会在明年推翻该州的堕胎禁令，并结束不公正划分的立法选区的使用，

sentences.en: that have given Republicans a lock on power in the state.
sentences.zh: 正是这些选区让共和党人牢牢掌握了该州的权力。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday, Finland became NATO's 31st member state, a defeat for Russian President Vladimir Putin, who was determined to block NATO's expansion,
sentences.zh: 周二，芬兰成为北约第31个成员国，这对决心阻止北约扩张的俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京来说是一个挫折，

sentences.en: but instead galvanized Finland, which borders Russia, to join the alliance as a response to Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 但它反而激发了与俄罗斯接壤的芬兰加入该联盟，以回应俄罗斯对乌克兰的入侵。

sentences.en: During a ceremony, the Finnish flag was raised at NATO's headquarters, and the alliance's leader pointedly warned Russia that NATO would keep getting stronger.
sentences.zh: 在仪式期间，芬兰国旗在北约总部升起，该联盟领导人明确警告俄罗斯，北约将继续变得更加强大。

sentences.en: President Putin wanted to slam NATO's door shut.
sentences.zh: 普京总统想要关上北约的大门。

sentences.en: Today, we show the world that he failed, that aggression and intimidation do not work.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们向世界展示他失败了，侵略和恐吓是没有用的。

sentences.en: Instead of less NATO, he has achieved the opposite, more NATO.
sentences.zh: 他没有得到更少的北约，反而达到了相反的效果——更多的北约。

sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛扎诺的原创音乐，

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《割草机秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片才能睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何地方收听《割草机秀》。
